subject.title: [Bug]: Codex app-server reply-session-init conflict leaves the session with no transcript mirror → tool-results silently return empty with no self-heal

question: Which open self-heal PR should be the canonical fix path for this issue and the broader reply-session-init conflict cluster?
rationale: Both linked PRs are still open and touch shared session lifecycle recovery, so ClawSweeper should not queue another repair or close the issue before maintainers choose the landing path and proof bar.

options.title: Use this issue as canonical until a PR lands
options.body: Keep this issue open, review the linked self-heal PRs, and close it only after a proven fix merges.

options.title: Promote the broader cross-channel report
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102020 the canonical tracker if maintainers want the cross-channel symptom to own the cluster, preserving this issue's Codex mirror evidence by link.

options.title: Wait for stronger live proof
options.body: Keep the issue and candidate PRs open until a repeated-conflict recovery is demonstrated on a real or Crabbox-backed session.

recommendation.title: Use this issue as canonical until a PR lands
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, review the linked self-heal PRs, and close it only after a proven fix merges.

likelyOwner.reason: Current main blame points to this owner on the shared session lifecycle code that maintainers need to review before landing a self-heal.
